featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.
The CAB-UAOC-15 is an active optical cable supporting extension of USB signals ranging from 2.0 up to the 3.2 Gen 2 spec, meaning this cable can support 10Gbps at a distance of 15

The USB Type A Female connector allows universal compatibility with almost any USB device. Just simply connect the USB cable that came with your device to the CAB-UAOC-15 and you are up and running. No software or drivers required.
